Los titulares proceden del RSS de Yahoo.en: Yahoo Finance RSS headlines are grouped by instrument. Publication times are converted to New York time and assigned to the first available session on or after that date. News at or after 16:00 is assigned to the next session. Early closes require a dedicated exchange calendar. This explores coincidence, not causation. DeepSeek sentiment reflects headline tone and has limitations.

Variación diaria = (último cierre / cier.en: Daily change = (latest close / previous close − 1) × 100. N-session reaction = (close at session N / close before the associated session − 1) × 100. Only complete windows are shown. Highs and lows use closes, not intraday extremes. Total return and dividends are excluded. Corporate-action adjustments may differ by provider.
Variación diaria = (último cierre / cier.zh-Hans: 日涨跌幅 =（最新收盘价 / 前收盘价 − 1）×100。N日反应 =（窗口第N日收盘价 / 关联日前收盘价 − 1）×100。仅显示完整窗口。最高最低使用收盘价，而非日内极值。不计算总回报或股息；不同来源的公司行为调整可能不同。

Las cuentas, listas, datos de fuentes y.en: Accounts, watchlists, source data and the last 30 conversation entries are stored in SQLite on this server. Assistant requests send your question, up to 8 previous messages and financial context to DeepSeek, without your password or email. Clear removes local chat history. Requested sentiment analysis sends up to 8 headlines. Local deletion does not delete data already processed by the provider.
